title: Phase-Free BindingSlots External Ephemeral Memory Fallback Evaluation
scientific_question: Can a session-scoped external temporary-memory table recover BindingSlots retrieval failures with deterministic identity, isolation, provenance and bounded overhead, while allowing BindingSlots to remain the normal fast path?
exclusions: storing raw slot vectors in the table
training the model against the table
lookup_key_proof: lookup_key_proof.json — legitimate key = entity id token in the query; stored value is the observed fact (not a label/oracle)
backend: SQLite (stdlib sqlite3) reference backend; no supported repo DB found
session_model: each needle example is an INDEPENDENT retrieval episode -> its own session (entity_id -> value unique within an episode); cross-session and cross-tenant lookups never disclose data
write_path: 1) ordinary BindingSlots write unchanged; 2) independently write the explicit fact record with session/tenant/version/expiry/evidence; the external write never alters model inputs/gradients/slot state
query_path: 1) ordinary BindingSlots inference; 2) compute the frozen trigger from runtime signals ONLY; 3) trigger false -> return BindingSlots result; 4) trigger true -> deterministic table lookup; 5) return table result with provenance. The table is NOT consulted before the trigger decision.

trigger.formula: fallback = low_top1_prob OR low_top1_margin OR high_entropy
trigger.key_verification: NOT used (no non-oracle slot-key to verify against for this task)
trigger.thresholds_source: FROZEN from the calibration cohort only (grid search); recorded with a calibration hash; NOT swept on the final eval cohort

calibration.procedure: grid search over prob/margin/entropy maximizing (failure recall, -unnecessary rate) with unnecessary-trigger rate <= 0.30 on the calibration cohort ONLY

final_cohort.reproduction: no checkpoints exist -> B0 == frozen run_h2 reproduced deterministically; reproduced trajectory must match committed B0 evidence; inference-only; no training change; no seed replacement

arms.T0: table only (reliability ceiling; not a neural result)
arms.V0: always-verify diagnostic (non-selectable; reads table every query)

latency_methodology: per-fallback table read latency via perf_counter; report p50/p95/p99; p95 gate vs frozen ceiling

success_gates_F1_all_required.2_rescue_ge_90pct: rescue >= 0.90 of M0 failures with valid lookup keys
success_gates_F1_all_required.10_p95_latency_within_ceiling: <= 0.050 s (frozen operational ceiling for the SQLite backend)

table_unavailable_behavior: return a structured fallback-unavailable/abstention result; preserve BindingSlots confidence signals; never fabricate a table result; record in the audit artifact
interpretation_supports_only: BindingSlots may remain the neural fast path while an external ephemeral table provides deterministic recovery and auditability when routing confidence is insufficient
does_not_support: table is an authoritative system of record
